narrative.northStar: 稿纸 — the manuscript sheet, marked with a red pen
narrative.overview: The panel is a sheet of squared manuscript paper. Instances are numbered entries with names written into square cells; failures are circled in red pen with what to do next. Depth comes from rules, not light; dark mode is carbon paper.
keyCharacteristics: green ink = action/selection, red pen = failure/destructive
Song serif titles, sans UI, mono figures
names in square cells, numbered entries, red-pen marks

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Only green and red are accent inks; green acts/selects, red flags failure or destruction.

rules.name: The Cell Rule
rules.body: Names use GridName: one CJK char per cell, Latin words merged, max 10 cells, never wraps.

rules.name: The No-Light Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows or blur; stand-out layers get the double frame.

dos: Circle failures with .pen-circle and explain with .pen-wave
donts: No drop shadows, glass, gradients or radial highlights
No emoji or Unicode glyph icons
No serif in buttons, labels or data
